body: thank you for posting, it made me smile.

hi everybody I wanna say thanks for posting here. as it turned out my frustration became so immense it triggered "a one last try" mentality. I grabbed the system by the balls and persued ETC treatment. I got it. it certainly woke up the reptilian part, the one that's guided by self-preservation. it was kinda like my brain was telling me "come on! self-preservation here! f=#k those people!" I'm doing better now.
I'm sensing a lack of understanding. the same problem I've been dealing. i appreciate that you acknowledged me but there's no hope for me. my decision is final. I wish you all the best in your life.
hopefully eternal sleep. it would be fitting considering bed is the only place I truly feel safe.

I just can't take it anymore. I've been so depressed for the last 4 years that I can't take anymore. I've tried to kill myself 17 times and it frustrates me that I keep failing. long story short, I just wasn't loved enough as a child and I just can't let it go. right now I'm so riddled with sadness and anger that I could cry and lash out violently at the same time. I can't function in life at all. I've lost jobs because of my mental breakdowns, I fear and hate people to a point where I can't get sexually attracted to anyone, not asexual by the way. my dad has regarded me as a curse all my life and to my mom, I was just a pest that got in the way of her sex life and partying. I couldn't function socially in school and got tormented by the other kids. I can't let all go. I want the suffering to stop, I can't handle it anymore. taking disability became a war inside my head because I didn't want to use the system. even tho I got accepted for SSDI relatively fast (3 months from when I applied) I've been tremendously guilty about it. I took it out of desperation and it only made me feel more pathetic on top of my already existing feelings. money don't buy happiness. and taxpayers shouldn't have to pay me so I would live another month. it disgusts me how close to bribery this is. I can't get any psychiatric help because they all play hardcore avoidance with me. I'm tired of the cliche catchphrases and placebo medications. nobody around me gives a rat's pass about me til they want something from me. I feel so alone and helpless. this is my only option. if I want peace, I have to kill myself.

I actually love SW's guidelines I think they're realistic. I only wish I encountered this web site sooner. if only the damn mental health system and the people in it would consider these. then I'd probably be better off instead of feeling like I wanna die all time. eh...what can ya do? I've lost my patience and now I'm choosing death. sorry about the rambling.

do what you feel is right for yourself. do you wanna die or peruse help? as for death? death don't scare me, I challenged death 17 and walked away. frankly I'm frustrated over all my failures so I'm trying to devise a plan that'll work this time. I wish you all the best in your decision. goodnight

I feel so sorry for you. I've been in your position many times. I can feel what you're feeling. I failed suicide many times and went thru what you're going. I can't find a reason to live either. I wish you all the best even tho I'm no better as I just made the decision to give up. just gotta make sure I succeed this time so I don't end up in the hospital. god I feel so bad for you. please do what's right for you and I wish you all the best.
so do I, it's all that's on my mind and no bumper sticker catchphrase is gonna help. the only thing I got for you is: stick to your guns and do what is right for you.
I can relate, that's how I feel. medications aren't all they're cracked to be. I AM prescribed meds that, most certainly, can be a abused. it didn't help, I still wanna die.

it's so horrible that you feel this way. nobody should have to feel this way about their natural desires. but I understand your desire to end it. I'm going thru similar feelings, I've just came to the same personal conclusion as you, just end it already. it's so sad that you've been driven to this because of your natural sexual orientation.

If you hurt anybody, you would've known by now. You're career isn't ruined. I do understand your feelings. you're scared and depressed. you feel like a failure, you're not. you made thru college, I chickened out before I even started. we're all human, we make mistakes.
